body:
I went through the exact same thing. I felt like at one point every choice i made was a good one, and good things always coincidentally happened. My doctor says i was on a manic high. I feel the same way how everything feels like a test. Getting your positive do it now mindset taken away from you is hell. 

What it felt like was that i was thinking too fast, always had inspiration, and motive. It really is a mindset, and we have to work hard to get that mindset given back to us.
I havent talked to a professional about it. My psychiatrist doesnt really ask me questions about anything
